text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to help Taiki Shuttle further hone
her skills, we've joined
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Across the line!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Whew. Was that the last item on the training schedule?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! There's actually something I'd like
us to do together.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What goes hand in hand with summer
camp? That's right—a barbecue!
I've been
itchin' to throw one for the longest time!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I was so fired up, I scoured every website
and book I could find.
There are lots of
delicious foods out there in nature!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So let's gather up some of those super
fresh ingredients and have a
barbecue
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She should really be resting after her
training session, but those
sparkling eyes
make it hard to turn her down.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo, good! ♪ Thank ya! Then let's get
going!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hmm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to look both ways, now.
According to one of the books I
read,
there should be mushrooms growing
around here.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I bet they're even fresher than the ones ya
find at the grocery store.
So let's get
lookin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Look over there, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Look at those colorful red and white spots!
Could that be one of
those legendary
mushrooms that turns ya into a giant when
ya eat it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Can't take your eyes off it, huh? Do ya
really wanna eat it that badly?
Okay, say
no more! I'll go get it!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Poisonous?! Oh, that's a real shame. It
looked so cool...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Then how 'bout that one? The
rainbowy coloring makes it look
really
tasty!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wondering if she actually just wanted to
pick mushrooms, I continue
to follow Taiki
as she bounces happily through the trees.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, we emerge to find ourselves on
a sandy beach.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! We found the ocean, Trainer! Ya know
what that means—shellfish
and sea urchins
galore! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I can stop her, Taiki races out into
the water.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whew! I found a whole slew of shellfish!
I'm sure there are some you'll
like in here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Anywhoo, please follow me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may be summer, but she could still catch
a cold running around
soaking wet like
that.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No! They gotta be fresh! Only the most
delicious ingredients will do!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Now, let's continue the hunt! Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Look, Trainer—a crop field! We've
stumbled on a real treasure
trove here!
Japanese veggies are downright delicious!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There just happens to be somebody out
pluckin' the produce right
now. I'm gonna
ask if he'll share his haul if we lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's go! Go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Up we go... Whew. Okay, mister! I finished
pulling all the weeds!

text_block_list.name: Farmer
text_block_list.text:
Hoo boy! Thanks for the help, you two. Go
ahead and help yourself
to those
vegetables I promised.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay, thank ya! Hehe. Which veggies would
ya like, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Once we've decided, it'll finally be time
for the grand finale!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it'll be no problem—trust me! Come
on, Trainer! Hurry up and
make your picks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After selecting my preferred vegetables at
Taiki's urging, I follow her
to our next
location.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to our very own happy barbecue
party! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There on the beach is a fully equipped
barbecue set, seemingly
borrowed from
the summer camp facilities.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I woke up bright and early to
get it ready!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I sure am glad ya didn't say no when I
asked ya to help me hunt for
ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We ended up getting our hands on a bunch of fresh ingredients, so this barbecue's sure to be a special and delicious affair!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Please accept this as a little gift from me
to you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank ya for all your help, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I'm feeling lonely, you're always
there for me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So even though I'm away from my family,
my days are full of smiles!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And also, I realized something. You're not
just my trainer...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're my precious Japanese family!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want ya to experience a bona
fide barbecue, just like I
used to have with
my family back home!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes! Operation Surprise was a great
success!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right, Trainer! Tell me what ya wanna
start with, and leave the rest
to me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I gathered each and every ingredient just
for you! They're all here for
ya to enjoy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll pour my heart into grillin' em up real
nice, so be sure to eat your
fill!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon, both my stomach and heart are full
to bursting from Taiki's
barbecue.
